title: Average BTC price on the 29th of each month
description: Read the BTC/USD Chainlink-style feed's historical rounds closest to the 29th of each requested month and return the straight average with per-month readings attached. One accepted job covers one report: fetch rounds, compute, submit.
requirements: Access to historical round data for a BTC/USD feed (onchain rounds preferred)
Ability to select the round nearest each target date deterministically
deliverables: Per-month readings (date, round id, price) plus the average
Result submitted as keccak(canonical JSON bytes of the report)
context: Index products, payroll benchmarks, and treasury marks all need 'the price on date X'. When readings come from onchain historical rounds, the report is self-proving: every number resolves to a round anyone can look up. Prefer onchain rounds over API quotes; declare the source in the result.

params.note: Originator fills the feed address and month list before posting; onchain rounds beat API quotes

asserts: each monthly reading resolves to a real historical round at or before the target date
no nearer round exists between the cited round and the target date
the average is the exact arithmetic mean of the cited readings
the data source (feed address or API) is declared in the report
verification.resultCommitment: keccak(canonical JSON bytes of the report)
